findings.detail: The flagged Metropolis Technologies position is disclosed under Other Equity with amortized cost 20 and fair value 285, but the extracted holding classified it as DIRECT_LENDING/PRIVATE_CREDIT.

rationale: X07 fired because the extracted row treated the position as non-equity, but the raw schedule places the matching Metropolis Technologies position in the Other Equity section. The numeric cost and fair value match the source in thousands, so the localized error is classification/scope, not the 20 cost or 285 fair value values.
